method: Prospective two-sided paired Student-t working-model power under normally distributed paired differences, population standardized effect delta/sigma_D=1, Bonferroni alpha 0.05/7, and scipy.stats.nct from scipy==1.18.0. Seventeen clusters is the minimum with conditional per-estimand model power at least 0.8; 20 is frozen before outcome access and must not be reduced.
assumptions: The independent unit is one fresh-world replicate cluster, not a personality lane or cell.
The minimum relevant paired cluster difference is 3 Core-3 stages on the 0-30 replicate-arm scale.
The standard deviation of a paired cluster difference is at most 3 Core-3 stages.
All three personality lanes are summed before any registered contrast is formed.
Paired cluster differences are modeled as independent and normally distributed; mean and variance alone do not determine power without this working model.
Working-model power is at least 0.8 for each estimand conditionally under population delta/sigma_D=1; it is not 0.8 power to reject all seven hypotheses jointly.
The SD<=3 assumption is unsupported by historical paired data and is especially strong for the interaction contrasts, whose range is -60 to 60.
This is an assumption-driven prospective calculation; it does not claim an empirical variance estimate from the historical unpaired runs.
